reason: Catherine West publicly threatened to trigger a Labour leadership contest if no cabinet minister challenged by Monday and was described as a stalking horse. Although the exact Brexit phrase has not yet appeared, the closely linked leadership action and short May 15 deadline make West much likelier than the previously favored cabinet contenders to supply the forecasted quote.

Jorge Martin followed his French sprint victory with the May 10 Grand Prix win and moved within one point of Marco Bezzecchi. Bagnaia crashed and has now retired from three of five Sunday races, while Marc Marquez required a second operation and is targeting a late-May return, shifting the Czech-race favorite toward Aprilia's two leaders.

The UAE reported engaging exactly two more Iranian drones on May 10. Repeated Iranian attacks toward both Israel and the UAE make that pair still more dominant for a future two-country ballistic-missile launch.

Ollie Watkins scored again in Aston Villa's May 10 draw with Burnley, strengthening his lead for the opening Villa goal against Liverpool. Ross Barkley's goal in the same match merits adding him to the candidate set, while the other attacking starters move down modestly.

Inter beat Lazio 3-0 away on May 10, only days before the same clubs meet in the Coppa Italia final. The exact-match rehearsal, combined with Inter's league-title form, substantially strengthens Inter despite normal single-match upset risk.

Washington won the first pick in the NBA draft lottery, and multiple May 10 reports identify AJ Dybantsa as the expected selection and consensus prospect with the fewest weaknesses. Darryn Peterson remains the principal alternative, but the lottery-specific reporting justifies a much more concentrated forecast.

The May 9 reporting already named Sanju Samson the selection committee's frontrunner. Mumbai's elimination and Suryakumar Yadav's further poor May 10 outing modestly reinforce a captaincy change, moving more mass from the incumbent to Samson.

Daniel Dubois stopped Fabio Wardley to take the WBO heavyweight title, sharply weakening Wardley's path to inherit Usyk's WBA championship. Current WBA regular champion Kubrat Pulev is the most direct administrative successor, while Itauma and Dubois retain longer routes.

Unseeded Dino Prizmic followed his Rome win over Novak Djokovic by beating seeded Ugo Humbert 6-1, 7-5 and reaching the last 16. His current clay form and unseeded status fit a French Open second-round upset opponent much better than several previously listed players who are likely to be seeded.

Sorana Cirstea beat world No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka in Rome while Sabalenka reported lower-back and hip discomfort two weeks before Roland Garros. Sabalenka is reduced, Cirstea enters the candidate set, and Noskova, Swiatek and Andreeva retain the leading established paths to defeat Gauff.
